stem.text: A uniform electric field is represented by five horizontal field lines.

stem.alt: Five horizontal parallel field lines, all arrowed to the right, with points labelled P and Q between them.

stem.text: P and Q are two points in the field. The field causes a positively charged particle in a vacuum to move from P to Q.

A.text: The acceleration of the particle between P and Q is increasing.

B.text: The kinetic energy of the particle at P is the same as the kinetic energy of the particle at Q.

C.text: The force on the particle at Q is greater than the force on the particle at P.

D.text: Work is done on the particle as it moves from P to Q.
